text:
marta: Heads up — someone on Craigslist is giving away an old arcade cabinet for free. Could be a fun office project if we can haul it Friday evening. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/abc123

marta: It's a 2-player sit-down CRT unit, looks rough but working. Measured the cabinet from the photo roughly 34" wide. Need 3 people + vehicle. :truck:

kevin: Count me in — I have a van that fits. What time would pickup be?

eli: I can help too but the office stairs are narrow. Do we have elevator access after hours?

shilpa: @facilities any rules about moving big stuff through the main lobby or after hours?

facilities-bot: FYI: Building policy requires a move-in/out form submitted 48h before any large items and security escort for after-hours moves. Form: https://office.example/move-form

jonah: If elevator is available fine, otherwise I've done a cabinet down narrow stairs before — need at least 3 people to pivot. I can bring lifting straps.

marta: Measurements from the seller:
```
width: 34"
height: 72" (including the marquee)
depth: 30"
estimated weight: ~150 lb
```

kevin: OK I can pick it up at 6pm Friday and arrive back at the loading bay ~7pm. Who can meet at the warehouse at 5:30 to help load?

eli: 5:30 works for me. I'll bring a hand truck and ratchet straps. Also, do we have long extension cords in the office to test it once it's here?

shilpa: There's a 25ft orange extension reel in the AV closet labeled "events". I'll grab it and leave a note on the door. :thumbsup:

jonah: Also suggest a quick "rehab" session Sat afternoon — clean controls, swap out bad buttons, check marquee lamp, and test coin mech (or coin door removable). Who's up for that?

marta: Love it. Mini project night. Quick poll: react with ✅ if you can help rehab Sat 2pm, :raised_hand: if you can only do the pickup Fri, and 💀 if you can't make either.

kevin: ✅
eli: ✅
shilpa: :raised_hand:
jonah: ✅

marta: I'll submit the move form now and DM security for after-hours pickup. Thanks everyone — I'll update this thread with the confirmed pickup address and seller contact.

marta: Also, if anyone has a torque wrench or spare marquee bulb, bring it! :sparkles:
